data.body: Landed via Gerrit change https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1037 (merged as bf9fb62a6, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved). Pass-1 per-call usage threaded end-to-end: passes.pass1_chunk/pass1_container/pass1_isf now return (findings, usage) pairs and summarize_for_isf returns (text, usage); sizing.pass1_with_ladder mints one usage record per COMPLETED attempt (raising attempts + checkpoint-served chunks contribute nothing); the container fan-out embeds usage in pairing_record['usage']; run_focused_finder returns (records, findings, usage) summed over its run_bin calls; ProductionBatchRunner emits BatchRunResult.outputs['_usage'] (per_call + per_criterion + totals; multi-criterion chunks split token fields equally, requests + derived llm_calls count in full); _attach_plan_review_metrics folds token totals into coverage.metrics and attaches coverage.usage; sidecar build_payload carries coverage.usage = {per_call, per_criterion}. All external callers (eval_solver, criterion_preview, fidelity_spot_eval) updated. Tests: new tests/unit/workflow/test_pass1_usage.py (15 tests, FakeRunner-delegating usage-stub wrapper); full unit suite 5870 passed, interfaces suite green.
